summary_en: This note introduces approximate identities (summability kernels) on \(\mathbb{R}^d\), explains their algebraic motivation via the convolution algebra \((L^1(\mathbb{R}^d),*)\), and states the main convergence results for convolution with an approximate identity in \(L^p\), uniformly continuous, and locally continuous settings.

problems.statement_en: Definition (Approximate identity / summability kernel). A family of integrable functions \(K_\lambda(x)\in L^1(\mathbb{R}^d)\), \(\lambda>0\), is called an approximate identity if: (1) \(\int_{\mathbb{R}^d} K_\lambda(x)\,dx=1\); (2) \(\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}|K_\lambda(x)|\,dx\le A\) uniformly in \(\lambda\); (3) for every \(\delta>0\), \(\int_{|x|\ge \delta}|K_\lambda(x)|\,dx\to 0\) as \(\lambda\to\infty\).
problems.statement_zh: 对于一个\(\mathbb{R}^n\)上的可积的函数族\(K_{\lambda}(x)\in L(\mathbb{R}^d),\lambda>0\): 1. 函数积分为1：\(\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}K_{\lambda}(x)dx=1\)；2. 绝对值的积分的一致有界性：\(\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}|K_{\lambda}(x)|dx\leq A\)并且\(A\)与参数\(\lambda\)无关；3. 绝对值积分的任意尾部都衰减到0：对任意的\(\delta>0\)，\(\int_{|x|\geq\delta}|K_{\lambda}(x)|dx\to0,\text{ as }\lambda\to\infty\)。也可以称之为“可求和的核”（Summability Kernel）。

problems.statement_en: Example/Construction. If \(K\in L^1(\mathbb{R}^d)\) and \(\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}K(x)\,dx=1\), then defining \(K_\lambda(x):=\lambda^d K(\lambda x)\) yields an approximate identity. The key verification is that for every \(\delta>0\), \(\int_{|x|\ge \delta}|K_\lambda(x)|dx = \int_{\mathbb{R}^d}|K(y)|\chi_{|y|\ge \lambda\delta}\,dy \to 0\) as \(\lambda\to\infty\).
problems.statement_zh: 一个简单的构造途径：由一个绝对可积的，并且在整个\(\mathbb{R}^d\)上积分为1的函数\(K(x)\)经由 \(K_{\lambda}(x):=\lambda^dK(\lambda x)\) 来构成。主要验证第三个条件的满足，此时 \(\int_{|x|\geq\delta}|K_{\lambda}(x)|dx= \int_{\mathbb{R}^d} |K(y)|\chi_{|y|\geq \lambda\delta}\,dy \to 0,\text{ as }\lambda \to \infty\)。

problems.statement_en: Definition (Algebra terminology). A linear space equipped with a closed bilinear binary operation is called an algebra. If the multiplication satisfies associativity, it is an associative algebra; if there exists \(I\in V\) such that \(a\cdot I=a\) for all \(a\in V\), it is unital; if \(a\cdot b=b\cdot a\) for all \(a,b\in V\), it is commutative.
problems.statement_zh: 如果给一个线性空间配备一个封闭且具有双线性性的二元运算，那么这是一个“代数”(algebra)。如果乘法满足结合律，称之为结合代数；如果乘法具有单位元，即存在一个 \(I\in V\) 使得 \(a\cdot I=a,\forall a\in V\)，称之为有单位的代数；如果乘法具有交换律，即 \(a\cdot b=b\cdot a\)，称之为交换代数。

problems.statement_en: Theorem (Young's inequality for convolution on Euclidean space). If \(1\le p,q,r\le \infty\) and \(\frac1p+\frac1q=\frac1r+1\), then \(\|f*g\|_{L^r}\le \|g\|_{L^p}\|f\|_{L^q}\). In particular, when \(r=p=q=1\), \(\|f*g\|_{L^1}\le \|g\|_{L^1}\|f\|_{L^1}<\infty\).
problems.statement_zh: 欧氏空间上卷积的Young不等式：\(1\leq p,q,r \leq \infty,\frac{1}{p}+\frac{1}{q} = \frac{1}{r} + 1\)，那么 \(\|f*g\|_{L^r}\leq \|g\|_{L^p}\|f\|_{L^q}\)。此处只需要令 \(r=p=q=1\)，那么此时就得到 \(\|f*g\|_{L^1}\leq \|g\|_{L^1}\|f\|_{L^1}<\infty\)。

problems.statement_en: Theorem. The space \(L^1(\mathbb{R}^d)\) equipped with convolution forms a commutative associative algebra: convolution is closed on \(L^1\), bilinear, commutative, and associative. However, this algebra has no identity element.
problems.statement_zh: 这个线性空间上如果我们给它装备一个由两个函数卷积构成的二元运算，此时 \((L^{1}(\mathbb{R}^d),*)\) 是一个代数，并且二元运算满足交换律和结合律：1. 封闭性，也就是说两个可积函数的卷积还是可积的；2. 双线性性；3. 可交换性，也就是 \(f*g=g*f\)；4. 满足结合律。同样由Fubini定理保证。但是这个代数没有单位元。

problems.statement_en: Theorem (Three basic results for approximate identities). Let \(K_\lambda\) be an approximate identity in \((L^1(\mathbb{R}^d),*)\). (1) If \(f\in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)\), \(1\le p\le \infty\), then \(f*K_\lambda\in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)\) and \(\|f*K_\lambda-f\|_{L^p}\to 0\) as \(\lambda\to\infty\). (2) If \(f\) is bounded and uniformly continuous on \(\mathbb{R}^d\), then \(f*K_\lambda\) is also bounded and uniformly continuous, and \(f*K_\lambda\rightrightarrows f\) as \(\lambda\to\infty\). (3) If \(f\) is bounded on \(\mathbb{R}^d\) and continuous on an open set \(\Omega\subset \mathbb{R}^d\), then \(f*K_\lambda\) is bounded and uniformly continuous on \(\mathbb{R}^d\), and for every compact set \(D\subset \Omega\), \(f*K_\lambda\rightrightarrows f\) on \(D\) as \(\lambda\to\infty\).
problems.statement_zh: 逼近单位的三个基本结果：1. \(f \in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d),1\leq p\leq \infty\)，那么 \(f * K_{\lambda}\in L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)\) 并且 \(\|f * K_{\lambda}-f\|_{L^p}\to 0,\text{ as }\lambda\to \infty\)；2. 如果函数 \(f\) 在 \(\mathbb{R}^d\) 上一致连续并且有界，那么 \(f*K_{\lambda}\) 也是一致连续并且有界的，并且 \(f * K_{\lambda}\rightrightarrows f \text{ as }\lambda \to \infty\)；3. 如果函数 \(f\) 在 \(\mathbb{R}^d\) 上有界并且在开集 \(\Omega\subset \mathbb{R}^d\) 上连续，那么 \(f*K_{\lambda}\) 在 \(\mathbb{R}^d\) 上有界且一致连续，此外对于任意的紧子集 \(D \subset \Omega\) 都有 \(f * K_{\lambda}\rightrightarrows f \text{ as }\lambda \to \infty\)。

key_techniques_discussed: construction of approximate identities by dilation
splitting the integral into near and far parts
